read_scope: Complete subject source and complete author synthetic suite plus own generated tiny arrays and parent-ivecs fixtures only. No actual GT, saved labels, count rows, vectors, graph or ANN were read/run by this reviewer.
checked_contracts: Frozen diagnosis protocol and P3 NOPASS gate bind exact completed search/structure analyses; both datasets, model families, P0 audit, partition branches/labels and extracted fit GT identity are checked before raw diagnostic inputs.

The original parent GT loader reads exactly NQ*404 bytes once for physical records0..9999, validates every width100 header, hashes all100 GT values per pilot row and takes ranks0..9 for metrics. Parent suffix is never read, memmapped or rehashed; whole-file size stat is explicitly separate.

Only existing raw fit GT10 is opened;20000x10 signed IDs, checksum, unique10 per row, ID range and manifest/P0 full-fit identity are validated. No query vectors, base vectors, original adjacency, validation or heldout are opened.

D and absolute covered targets are integer-derived over all256 leaves; stable ascending-leaf ties match the oracle, including zero-mass ties. Saved region order is exact; conditional weights use fixed1e-12 absolute tolerance for equivalent floating expression.

Full-GT selected top4 is reused for both support groups. covered_seen+covered_unseen==full and hits_seen+hits_unseen==full hold in exact integers; contributions use fixed denominator10, subgroup ratios use target-slot denominators and empty=null. D_seen/D_unseen explicitly do not add to full D.

Fit support counts row incidence because GT10 rows are unique; all fit targets are seen by construction. Unique-node and pilot targetslot population denominators are separate, including repeated unseen target occurrence across queries.

Any-pass leaf and coarse movement catches a pass1 move returning in pass2; final and cross-lambda differences are reported separately. All saved labels receive shape/hash/capacity rechecks; raw graph cut is explicitly inherited.
All11 exact k_seen bins, D1..10 and covered-count0..10 bins retained, including empties. Candidate/reference direction is explicit for three structure changes and ten search contrasts.

Original8 fixed contrasts are reconstructed against saved Recall/sign/NDC summaries, plus exactly2 predeclared oracle_unified lambda1-minus-lambda0 comparisons. All both-L/dataset cells retained with per-stratum oracle counters, no counter allocation to support groups.
Result hits are independently recomputed from saved IDs and pilot GT, then checked against saved Recall. All four oracle queue/L routes per model match; legacy Fast batches are excluded entirely.

Compact fit/pilot NPZ saves metrics/hits/counters without rawGT/results/node dump. Exclusive outputs and complete-last markers preserve failures; no bootstrap, CI, refit, selection, P3 reopening or new-method authorization.

limits: Full saved count/model/evaluator integrity is inherited from the already accepted exact-hash P3 analysis; this reader does not reimplement all prior timer/portal ownership checks.
Same fitted-model route agreement plus GT-mass agreement is checked; this is an oracle structural diagnosis, not learned prediction generalization.
Observed fit/pilot or seen/unseen differences can reflect support/popularity and distribution differences. They do not prove memorization, leakage, or a connectivity bottleneck.
Actual full datasets have not been run by this reviewer; root controlled serial execution and final completion markers remain required.
